DIRECTOR: Hello, I'm Anna Duma, the director of the shelter
FIRST_DIV_DIRECTOR: Every day we work to create a real shelter for animals that saves lives, helps find safe and the best conditions for each animal, and gives them a chance for a happy future in loving families.
SECOND_DIV_DIRECTOR: - is the main condition of a humane and good society. That's why creating conditions for rescue and care for tails - is the main mission of "Kindness". This is our daily motivation and inspiration, our contribution to a better future.
VOLUNTEER: Hello, I'm Alla Shop, the main curator of adoption
FIRST_DIV_VOLUNTEER: Every day I take care of it so that each rescued animal receives not only care and warmth, but also finds a safe home and a loving family. For me, the most important thing is to give a chance to an animal that has endured pain or indifference to feel trust in people again.
SECOND_DIV_VOLUNTEER: - is to find the best conditions and responsible owners so that our wards receive genuine care and have a happy future.
THIRD_DIV_VOLUNTEER: This is my daily mission and contribution to a better future for those who cannot speak for themselves but desperately need love and protection.
VET: Hello, I'm Ivan Dyak, the veterinarian at the shelter
FIRST_DIV_VET: My daily work is to take care of the health of rescued animals. I deal with treatment, rehabilitation, sterilization, and many other procedures so that each animal has a chance for a long and happy life.
SECOND_DIV_VET: - is not only to heal, but also to prepare animals for a new stage of life in loving families.
THIRD_DIV_VET: This is my mission, my daily call, and the greatest reward - to see how once weak and abandoned animals become healthy, strong, and happy.

ABOUT_US_TITLE: About us and what we do
ABOUT_US_DESCRIPTION: Dobrodiy is a non-profit project aimed at systematically solving the problem of homeless animals in humane ways. Thanks to this free online resource, you can find yourself a pet or help a homeless animal find a family.
ABOUT_US_MISSION_DESCRIPTION: Give a chance at life to those whom war has left homeless and loveless. We believe that even in the darkest times, humanity is our strongest tool. Helping animals also means helping the country; it means saving lives.
ABOUT_US_MISSION_PARAGRAPH1: The animals are socialised and ready for adoption.
ABOUT_US_MISSION_PARAGRAPH2: Successful rescues in Ukraine and in other countries.
ABOUT_US_MISSION_PARAGRAPH3: Animals rescued from the beginning of a full-scale war.
ABOUT_US_HISTORIES_DESCRIPTION: Many of our adopted pets find new families, become symbols of strength and love that overcome fear.
ABOUT_US_WHY_WE_ARE_DOBRODIIY_DESCRIPTIO: We are not just a shelter. We are a community of people who believe: helping animals, we save humanity!

The name of our shelter is no coincidence. A ‘Dobrodii’ is someone who does good deeds without expecting anything in return. This applies to each and every one of us. To the volunteers who feed puppies at night. To the woman who brings a bag of food, even though she herself lives modestly. It is about the boy who comes every Sunday to pet a cat because there is war at his home.
ABOUT_US_WE_ARE_FAMOUS_TITLE: We are famous around the world!
ABOUT_US_WE_ARE_FAMOUS_DESCRIPTION1: Dogs, cats and other animals from “Dobrodiy” have already found shelters in Germany, Sweden, Netherlands, Czechia and other countries
ABOUT_US_WE_ARE_FAMOUS_DESCRIPTION2: The ‘Dobrodiy’ shelter is now known far beyond Ukraine's borders. After the full-scale invasion, our rescue stories spread on social media, in the media, and through international charitable organisations. And this is a real chance for our animals.
ARTICLES_DESCRIPTION: Memories of cats and dogs who found their families, love and care live here. They prove that good triumphs!
SHELTER_NEWS_DESCRIPTION: Dobrodiy is a non-profit project aimed at systematically solving the problem of homeless animals in humane ways. Thanks to this free online resource, you can find yourself a pet or help a homeless animal find a family.
SUPPORT_LINE_PARAGRAPH1: As pet owners, or those who are just considering bringing a pet into their home, you have many questions about the daily aspects of raising and adopting a pet at home. Our experts are here to help.
SUPPORT_LINE_PARAGRAPH2: We have prepared a series of useful tips, recommendations and answers to the most common questions for you: how to introduce your pet to a new space, what to do in case of fear or stress, how to establish a feeding and walking routine, and how to make the first days at home comfortable for both you and your new friend. Do not hesitate to contact us — together we can create true harmony in your family. Because every animal deserves care, and every guardian deserves support.

ADOPTION_TITLE_DESCRIPTION: If you want to give a home to a cat, read the adoption rules:
ADOPTION_RULE1: Surrender - it is not spontaneous. You take responsibility for the live thing for years.
ADOPTION_RULE2: The cat needs daily care: grooming, brushing, communication, treatment.
ADOPTION_RULE3: The space must be safe and clean. Anything that could damage the animal mast be removed.
ADOPTION_RULE4: The family must be ready to accept the cat. Return is not allowed.
ADOPTION_RULE5: Before euthanasia, you must meet the cat, so you can understand if it is the right choice.
ADOPTION_RULE6: You sign a document that confirms your responsibility. We care about everyone.
ADOPTION_RULE7: If you are not sure if you are ready - better be a volunteer or a caretaker at a distance.
ADOPTION_RULE8_TITLE: You have made a decision to take the cat!
ADOPTION_RULE8: You understand that you are ready to take a friend into your family, then we are happy to help you.
ADOPTION_CONCLUSIONS: What is important to know before adoption
ADOPION_CONCLUSION1: All animals older than 6 months are sterilized. Young animals (puppies, kittens) are only transferred with written consent for sterilization after reaching the appropriate age.
ADOPION_CONCLUSION2: We do not transfer tails to third parties for security, business, or “unexpected surprises.”
ADOPION_CONCLUSION3: You can only pick up your pet in person by coming to the shelter. Other options (such as transfer outside the shelter or region) are discussed separately.
ADOPION_CONCLUSION4_TITLE: A carrying case or ammunition is a must-have.
ADOPION_CONCLUSION4: If you are going to walk your cat, take a carrier. If you are going to walk your dog, a collar and leash are mandatory for the animal's safety.
ADOPION_REJECTION_TITLE: Cases in Which We May Refuse Animal Adoption
ADOPION_REJECTION_DESCRIPTION: We care about the safety and happiness of every animal, so we reserve the right to refuse adoption if:
ADOPION_REJECTION_CAUSE1: You plan to keep the animal on a leash, in an enclosure, or in a cage.
ADOPION_REJECTION_CAUSE2: You do not have a stable place of residence or are planning to relocate.
ADOPION_REJECTION_CAUSE3: You are experiencing temporary difficulties, unemployment, or debts.
ADOPION_REJECTION_CAUSE4: You are not willing to spay/neuter the animal or refuse to do so.
ADOPION_REJECTION_CAUSE5: Aggressive behavior or devaluation of the animal is detected during the conversation.
ADOPION_REJECTION_CAUSE6: You have previously returned animals to the shelter without a valid reason.
ADOPION_REJECTION_CAUSE7: False information is provided, inconsistencies between statements and facts are found.
